entries.title: Reference resolution determinism across HashMap iteration orders
entries.summary: Order-independent alias cycle collapsing in collapse_alias_cycles.
highlights: Reference resolution determinism across HashMap iteration orders. Replaced "first match wins" scans with deterministic candidate ranking (pick_deterministic_candidate) ordering candidates by same-file locality, lexicographical FQN, and UUID tie-breaking

Order-independent alias cycle collapsing in collapse_alias_cycles. Path-compresses the entire walk (including tails leading into cycles) in chain_terminal to ensure canonical representative mapping regardless of key iteration order.
Documented reference resolution determinism contract in README.md.

Added 5 regression tests in src/pipeline/ingest/resolve/mod.rs and aliases.rs covering FQN substring collisions, same-file preference, class suffix collisions, VCL basename collisions, and alias tail-into-cycle independence.

entries.title: Deterministic UUID v5 generation for HTML/JSX markup entities…
entries.summary: Previously created with random Uuid::new_v4(), markup entities now derive stable v5 UUIDs from entity parameters, eliminating Qdrant and Neo4j churn on incremental re-indexing.
highlights: Deterministic UUID v5 generation for HTML/JSX markup entities (HtmlId, HtmlClass, HtmlElement). Previously created with random Uuid::new_v4(), markup entities now derive stable v5 UUIDs from entity parameters, eliminating Qdrant and Neo4j churn on incremental re-indexing.

UUID v5 collision disambiguation pass (disambiguate_entity_uuids) for distinct entities sharing identical identity keys ({repo_name}:{file_path}:{fqn}:{start_line}). Entities colliding on base identity (such as TypeScript arrow-function constants exported as both a constant and function, same-line re-exports, or duplicate HTML classes) are deterministically ordered and assigned disambiguated v5 UUIDs ({base identity}:{kind label}:{name}#{n}).

Non-colliding entities retain their existing UUIDs bit-for-bit, preserving index state version compatibility without forcing a full re-index (--clean remains optional; existing indexes self-heal file by file upon re-indexing).

entries.title: list_files no longer fabricates a total in its truncation notice
entries.summary: The reply carries total_matches — exact when the scan consumed every candidate, flagged by total_is_lower_bound when it stopped at the cap — and the notice renders Showing first 2000 of 3471 files or…
highlights: list_files no longer fabricates a total in its truncation notice. The reply carries total_matches — exact when the scan consumed every candidate, flagged by total_is_lower_bound when it stopped at the cap — and the notice renders Showing first 2000 of 3471 files or Showing first 2000 of more than 2000 files instead of the invented N + 1.

plain-prefix list_files queries no longer drop valid files. The graph's STARTS WITH is a superset of the path-boundary rule (src/api also returns src/api-notes.md), and the single unfiltered read let more than 2000 non-matching siblings consume the whole window. Prefix queries now page the graph and apply the boundary filter per page, and truncation is decided on the filtered count only.
the list_files pager has an absolute MAX_SCAN_PAGES iteration cap, so a backend that ignores SKIP terminates with a truncated result instead of looping forever.

explore_file now segregates attribute-usage markup tokens (html_class, html_id) into a compact summary section by default, preventing Tailwind classes and ID tokens from inflating code lists. Genuine module-level declarations (constant), CSS declarations (css_class, css_id), custom HTML elements (html_element), and all 110 wire entity kinds now map to dedicated buckets instead of falling into Other Entities. Added --include-markup (CLI) and include_markup (MCP) to expand the full markup reference list on demand.

entries.title: Upgrade knot to 1.11.1
entries.summary: Updated the knot dependency from 1.11.0 to 1.11.1 to pick up upstream patch fixes; no API or indexing changes required.
highlights: Upgrade knot to 1.11.1. Updated the knot dependency from 1.11.0 to 1.11.1 to pick up upstream patch fixes; no API or indexing changes required.

REST/MCP parity for dependency lookup (GET /api/repos/{id}/deps) — BREAKING: The response shape changed from a bare JSON array [{"repo_name": ...}] to an object {"dependencies": [...], "diagnostics": {...} | null, "depth": {...}}. When dependencies is empty, diagnostics is lazily populated with a structured explanation (e.g. declared dependencies that resolve to no indexed repo, stale graph, unindexed repo, or unmatchable build identity), establishing parity with list_repo_dependencies MCP tool.

Surface depth report: GET /api/repos/{id}/deps now surfaces a depth report object containing requested, effective, clamped, and ceiling (derived from knot core constants DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH and MAX_DEPTH_CEILING).
Silent clamping on /deps: A requested max_depth exceeding MAX_DEPTH_CEILING (10) or floored below 1 is now reported in depth.clamped and depth.effective.

entries.title: No Re-index Required (State Compatibility Window)
entries.summary: upgrading from a published v1.10.0 index needs no re-index and no configuration change on the default path.
highlights: upgrading from a published v1.10.0 index needs no re-index and no configuration change on the default path. IndexState no longer encodes model identity: the load gate becomes a compatibility window (state.version < 6 rejected, > 7 rejected as a downgrade), so a v6 index loads as-is. v7 adds only the absent-tolerant is_test_context vector-payload field and an optional embed_model marker to the state file. (The previously "published" v6→v7-bumpy default-model flip was planned here instead — no released knot ever shipped BGEBaseENV15 as the default.)

KNOT_EMBED_MODEL accepts exactly two models now — AllMiniLML6V2 (384-dim, the default, kept) and the opt-in BGEBaseENV15 (768-dim). The other four (BGESmallENV15, MultilingualE5Small, JinaEmbeddingsV2BaseCode, NomicEmbedTextV15) are removed — selecting one aborts startup listing the two accepted names. The model table (src/pipeline/embed/model.rs) is the single source of truth: name, fastembed variant, dimension, asymmetric prefixes and the default-collection suffix. The dimension is now derived from the model — KNOT_EMBED_DIM / --embed-dim are hidden and deprecated (an agreeing value warns; a contradicting one is a hard error).

the default model keeps the historical knot_entities collection; the opt-in model derives knot_entities_bge768 so the two live indexes can coexist without a collection-dimension collision. An explicitly set KNOT_QDRANT_COLLECTION (CLI/env/.env) always wins.

every index run persists the producing model on the repository's :Repository node. knot and knot-mcp run a startup guard: dimension mismatch with the collection → abort; every marked repository on another model → abort; some on another model → warning naming the invisible repositories; legacy index without markers → infer the model from the collection dimension (384 ⇒ AllMiniLML6V2, 768 ⇒ BGEBaseENV15) and proceed (never fail-closed), self-healing the marker on the next index run. The indexer additionally refuses an incremental run mixing models into one repository unless --clean is given, and search_hybrid_context returns an explicit note instead of a silent empty result when a scoped repository was indexed with another model.

entries.title: Upgrade knot to 1.11.0 (two-model embedding selection)
entries.summary: The default embedding model is AllMiniLML6V2 (384, on knot_entities) — upgrading from v0.7.0 with a MiniLM index needs zero re-index and zero configuration change.
highlights: Upgrade knot to 1.11.0 (two-model embedding selection). The default embedding model is AllMiniLML6V2 (384, on knot_entities) — upgrading from v0.7.0 with a MiniLM index needs zero re-index and zero configuration change. The supported set is closed to exactly two models: AllMiniLML6V2 (384, default) and BGEBaseENV15 (768, opt-in via KNOT_EMBED_MODEL). The previously accepted model names (BGESmallENV15, MultilingualE5Small, JinaEmbeddingsV2BaseCode, NomicEmbedTextV15) are removed upstream; selecting one now aborts with the two accepted names.

Derived dimension. The vector dimension is derived from KNOT_EMBED_MODEL (MiniLM → 384, BGE-base → 768). KNOT_SERVER_EMBED_DIM / --embed-dim are deprecated: an agreeing value still parses and warns (removed in the next major); a contradicting one aborts, because it means the operator believes a different model is active.

Derived collection. When KNOT_SERVER_QDRANT_COLLECTION is not explicitly set, the model's suffix is applied to the base default: MiniLM keeps knot_entities byte-for-byte; a BGE-base operator lands on knot_entities_bge768 automatically instead of colliding with a fixed-size collection. An explicit value always wins.

Marker-aware startup guard. Before any collection is touched, knot-server runs knot's guard ladder: it probes the Qdrant collection's real vector dimension and reads the per-repository embedding markers from the Neo4j :Repository nodes. Outcome: proceed silently (fresh deployment / everything agrees), abort with an actionable message naming the collection, both dimensions and the model (dimension mismatch / every marked repo on another model), or warn naming every repository indexed with the other model — those repos exist in the graph but are invisible to semantic search from this collection. A server running v0.7.0 was blind to partial model mixing; it now surfaces at startup instead of as silently missing semantic hits.

entries.title: Mandatory Re-index (State v6)
entries.summary: IndexState bumped from v5 to v6.
highlights: IndexState bumped from v5 to v6. Embed text schema now leads with a natural-language role sentence (<identifier_phrase>: <first_sentence(docstring)> or <identifier_phrase> — calls <top_callee_names>). Older indexes are incompatible and force knot-indexer --clean.
Configurable embedding model support via KNOT_EMBED_MODEL (supports AllMiniLML6V2 [default], BGESmallENV15, BGEBaseENV15, MultilingualE5Small, JinaEmbeddingsV2BaseCode, NomicEmbedTextV15).
Automatic query/passage instruction prefixing for asymmetric models (e.g. BGE, E5, Nomic). Fixed embed_query in fastembed 6 to correctly prepend model query prefixes.
validate_embed_pair ensures KNOT_EMBED_DIM matches the selected model's native dimension at startup, preventing mid-query Qdrant dimension mismatches.

entries.title: Embedding model guard
entries.summary: knot-server now resolves KNOT_EMBED_MODEL exactly as knot does and validates it against KNOT_SERVER_EMBED_DIM at startup, aborting with both dimensions named before any database is touched when the…
highlights: Embedding model guard. knot-server now resolves KNOT_EMBED_MODEL exactly as knot does and validates it against KNOT_SERVER_EMBED_DIM at startup, aborting with both dimensions named before any database is touched when the selected model's native dimension differs (e.g. a 768-dim model with the default 384 dimension). Mirrors knot's own validate_embed_pair guard.
Upgrade knot to 1.10.0. Updated the knot dependency to 1.10.0 to support Config.embed_model.

Compatibility with knot 1.10 Config.embed_model. Populate the new embed_model field when building knot::config::Config, sourced from the same KNOT_EMBED_MODEL variable that the indexer and search embedders read, so the indexing model and query model cannot drift apart.
Version-agnostic index-state test. The state-loading test now persists through IndexState::save() instead of hard-coding a schema version, so it survives IndexState bumps (v5 → v6).
